management.prescriber_action: Avoid ivabradine with any retained current-FDA moderate CYP3A inhibitor, including diltiazem, verapamil, grapefruit juice and conivaptan. Withhold the newly presented agent and clarify a non-interacting plan; do not stop established ivabradine.
management.monitoring: Heart rate and symptoms of bradycardia if exposure has already occurred. The cited label gives an avoid action but no universal monitoring interval for all moderate inhibitors.
management.patient_counselling: Report very slow pulse, dizziness, fainting, or shortness of breath.
management.exceptions: This exact-drug rule owns the 12 retained current-FDA moderate examples.
